fusions.name: Under the Henhouse Wire
fusions.desc: A low strike that deals 30 damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dirt in the Eyes
fusions.desc: Flings a spadeful of dirt in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Decoy Den
fusions.desc: Digs a false den at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles set it off: it deals 20 damage in a blast 2.5 tiles across.

fusions.name: Always a Back Door
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
